purpose: Separate portrait mobile portfolio visualizations based on the local employee-only auto shop project.

prompts.catalog:
Use case: ui-mockup. The attached reference is the desktop visual language of a real local employee-only auto parts shop tool. Generate ONE separate PORTRAIT MOBILE screen for its portfolio presentation, not a resized desktop screenshot. Tall 9:16 portrait composition, high resolution. Flat UI fills the entire image, no physical phone, no browser frame, no perspective, no decorative outside space.

Design the native-looking MOBILE “Каталог” screen in the same midnight/slate + blue/indigo design language. Strong readable Cyrillic typography, large primary text, generous 20px side padding on an imagined 390px wide screen, consistent 12px corners, thin dividers. Each primary label should be legible when the image is displayed at 350px width; use 16–18px-equivalent body text, 26px title, not miniature desktop UI. Only one clear task at a time. No sidebars, wide tables or right-hand detail columns. All content should fit inside this tall frame, with balanced vertical spacing.

Top small identity row: small approved abstract blue geometric shop icon, “Магазин”, quiet subtitle “Локальная система”; small account icon at right. Below heading “Каталог склада”. Full-width search “Артикул или название”. One neat filter row “Все бренды” and “Категории”. Small text “5 405 товаров”.
Main content is THREE large, tidy TEXT-ONLY inventory rows/cards with consistent alignment and generous whitespace. First selected with restrained indigo border:
1 “Масляный фильтр”; muted “RENAULT · 7700274177”; emerald “74 шт.”; prominent “400 ₽”; compact plus button on right.
2 “Шайба сливной пробки”; muted “MASUMA · MDP0023”; “50 шт.”; “50 ₽”; same plus button.
3 “Тормозные колодки”; “HI-Q · SP1243”; “46 шт.”; “1 050 ₽”; same plus button.
Below list full-width blue-purple action “Открыть чек · 2”. Allow quiet whitespace around action.
BOTTOM native tab bar, four equally spaced simple line icons and labels: “Каталог” selected in periwinkle, “Подбор”, “Остатки”, “Настройки”. The bar sits neatly at the bottom with a little safe-area padding. No tiny bottom text. No OS status bar or fake home indicator required.

Color: background #10141f, surfaces #181e2c, near-white text, quiet blue-gray secondary, primary indigo #5474ed with a hint of purple #8071ec; green only for stock. No yellow, cyan neon or excessive glow.
CRITICAL: do not draw any product imagery, thumbnails, filters, spark plugs, image frames, placeholder product boxes or part illustrations. No Armtek / Армтек / Stparts / Стпартс names, logos or URLs. No public cloud, customer login or invented new functions. This is a clear focused mobile presentation of the existing stock catalog.
prompts.analogs:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE separate portrait MOBILE screen for the portfolio presentation of the employee-only LOCAL auto parts shop system. FIRST reference is the desktop source content, SECOND reference is the APPROVED mobile catalog screen of the same app. Match the SECOND reference exactly: portrait 9:16 around 941×1672, graphite/slate background, clean large Cyrillic sans-serif, blue-indigo accents, generous consistent spacing and large touch controls. Preserve the SAME top identity “Магазин / Локальная система”, small abstract blue geometric icon and account icon. Preserve the SAME four-item bottom tab bar, icons and exact labels “Каталог”, “Подбор”, “Остатки”, “Настройки”, changing only selection. Mobile layout has ONE column, no sidebar or horizontal table. Body type should be 16–18pt equivalent on an imagined 390px-wide phone so it remains readable when scaled to 350px. Flat full-bleed screenshot, no phone hardware, OS status bar, browser chrome, mockup perspective, outside decoration or marketing claims.
IMPORTANT: no photos or illustrations of any auto part, no filter or spark plug images, no product thumbnails, no image frames. No Armtek, Армтек, Stparts, Стпартс names, logos or URLs. No yellow/cyan neon. Do not invent capabilities beyond the described fields.
Screen “Подбор аналогов”, bottom tab “Подбор” selected. Under app identity, title “Подбор аналогов” and muted “Из каталога — в наличие”.
Compact original-part summary: small eyebrow “ОРИГИНАЛЬНАЯ ДЕТАЛЬ”, title “Свеча зажигания”, text “HYUNDAI / KIA”, clearly spaced SKU “0K55818110”. Text-only summary, no part illustration. Below a two-option segmented control “Все · 191” and “В наличии · 2”, latter selected.
Main TWO well organized generous result cards. First subtle indigo selected state: large “NGK 4291”, secondary “Свеча зажигания”, stock “1 шт. на складе” emerald, large aligned “800 ₽”, compact blue plus button on right. Second “NGK 7100”, secondary same, “2 шт. на складе”, large “1 850 ₽”, plus button.
Below results short subdued confirmation with a small generic check icon: “Наличие проверено по складу”. Leave comfortable breathing room. Full-width blue-indigo action near bottom “Открыть чек · 2”. Same bottom navigation as reference. No floating tooltip or unnecessary extra cards. Fit all content neatly.
